title: Noor and the Debt
premise: Felix Nakamura, a crash investigator who lost her family in an unexplained accident, has built her life on anonymity—until a stranger named Noor arrives claiming Felix once saved her life, a favor Felix never performed, and insists the debt must be repaid with interest: the truth about row twelve. Following Noor's cryptic ledger, Felix uncovers that her family's crash was engineered to bury evidence of a transnational arms deal, implicating officials in three governments who now want her silenced. Hunted by an assassin codenamed Vesper and betrayed by the one colleague she trusted, Felix races to deliver the flight recorder data to an international tribunal before it can be destroyed. In the end, Noor sacrifices herself to buy Felix time, and Felix—no longer invisible—testifies under her real name, finally claiming both the truth and the found family Noor's network becomes.
about_author: Gideon Vasquez is a former aviation insurance adjuster turned novelist whose thrillers draw on two decades of reading between the lines of disaster reports. He writes from a coastal town he refuses to name, where he collects vintage flight recorders and unanswered questions.

chapters.title: The Favor That Never Happened
chapters.summary: POV Felix. A quiet forensic investigator's routine shatters when Noor appears at her office with a detailed account of a rescue Felix never performed—and a ledger demanding repayment in truths. The emotional beat is disorientation curdling into obsession as Felix recognizes details from row twelve that were never made public.

chapters.title: Interest Owed
chapters.summary: POV alternating Felix and Noor. Following the ledger across borders, Felix discovers the crash was staged to destroy evidence of an arms shipment, while Noor reveals fragments of her own past as the debt's original keeper. The beat is wary alliance—two women testing whether trust can be built on a lie.

chapters.title: Vesper
chapters.summary: POV Felix. The assassin closes in; Felix's trusted colleague betrays her location, forcing a brutal escape through a port city as three governments move to bury the tribunal filing. The climax peaks when Noor takes a bullet meant for Felix, handing over the final ledger page with the recorder's true coordinates.

chapters.title: Row Twelve, Spoken Aloud
chapters.summary: POV Felix. Grieving but resolved, Felix delivers the recovered data to the tribunal and testifies under her full name, dismantling the conspiracy as Vesper is exposed by Noor's surviving network. The resolution lands on inheritance redefined: not what Felix lost in row twelve, but the family she chose after it.
